items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: You consider the source. See, you know how I feel now. He didn't even mention me, so you know how factual he is about --

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Yeah. Well, no, Lester didn't go with Billie, you know. No, no. Billie and I were a little tight at one time, but, you know, nothing serious, you know. But I don't think Prez went with Billie at all. No. Rudy Blesh
According to Rudy Blesh they did.
